name: Relay coil with capacitor suppression
summary: A relay with a capacitor suppression element includes a documented capacitive network associated with the coil.
description: A relay with a capacitor suppression element includes a documented capacitive network associated with the coil. Its connection and effect on switching are product-dependent.
readingNotes: Check the coil voltage type and suppression configuration before substituting a relay assembly.
